map.格里高利历闰年判定：年份能被 4 整除且不能被 100 整除为闰年，或能被 40: Gregorian leap-year rule: a year is a leap year if it is divisible by 4 and not by 100, or if it is divisible by 400; written as (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0) or year % 400 == 0; a leap year has 29 days in February and 366 days in total, while a common year has 365.
map.1. 能被 4 整除但不能被 100 整除 → 闰年: 1. Divisible by 4 but not by 100 → leap year
map.2. 能被 400 整除 → 闰年（例外规则）: 2. Divisible by 400 → leap year (the exception rule)
map.其他年份为平年（365 天）: Other years are common years (365 days)
map.闰年二月有 29 天，全年 366 天: A leap year has 29 days in February and 366 days in total
map.示例：2000 ✓ 闰年；1900 ✗ 平年；2024 ✓ 闰年；2025 ✗: Examples: 2000 ✓ leap year; 1900 ✗ common year; 2024 ✓ leap year; 2025 ✗ common year

map.四年一闰、百年不闰、四百年再闰。: A leap year every four years, none every hundred, and again every four hundred.
